name: done-prepare-safe-auto-closeout
title: Add safe done_prepare generated-metadata auto-closeout
description:
Add a conservative opt-in done_prepare mode that closes only the mechanical generated-metadata loop exposed by B-6914.
The story must not duplicate B-eb08 heartbeat/progress, B-eb92 review-assurance surfacing, or B-b264 rerun-delta explanation.
It should commit only current-run Proofbound lifecycle metadata, reuse validation only when material/storyFiles/command/policy hashes are unchanged, and re-evaluate DONE prepare without auto-signing or publishing.
